label: Midline and Amplitude
subgoals: A sinusoidal graph oscillates around a midline.
If the maximum is 9 and the minimum is 3, the midline is 6 and the amplitude is 3.
The midline is a vertical shift, so it appears as a constant added to the sine or cosine term.

label: Period and Frequency
subgoals: The period is the horizontal length of one complete cycle.
Frequency counts cycles per unit and is the reciprocal of the period.
A phase shift moves the cycle left or right without changing its shape, amplitude or period.

label: Building a Model
subgoals: Choose sine or cosine according to the starting value, then set amplitude, period, phase shift and midline in that order.
Test the model at the start, at a quarter period and at half a period.
State the domain in which the model makes sense; a periodic model may not apply outside the observed interval.
